CONFIDENTIAL

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ________
S. 1, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date August 18, 19 39.

Subject Koo Ching Keng ( 過錦根 ), alleged member of the Chungking
Government Secret Service in Shanghai - assassinated
Made by. D.S.I. Liao Chung Chien Forwarded by C Crawford ?

At 6.45 p.m., August 17, 1939, one Koo Ching
Keng, a resident of No. 158 North Zao Ka Zah ( 曹
家宅 ), off Brenan Road, O.O.L., was fired upon
and killed in front of his house by certain unknown
person or persons.

It is reported that Koo was a member of the
Secret Service of the Chungking Government but
lost contact with the organization after a number
of the rendezvous of his fellow agents in the
French Concession had been raided by the French
Police in conjunction with the Japanese Military
in July 1939.

Since that time, he has resided at 158 Zao
Ka Zah but it was not long before his movements
and address became known to the Japanese Military
Police who immediately assigned one Chih Dah Mo
Bi ( 金大麻皮 ), an ex-member of the Chungking
Government Secret Service and at present working
as a secret agent with the Japanese Gendarmerie,
to persuade Koo to surrender. It is reported
that Chih called on Koo in the evening of August 17
and when the latter steadfastly refused to yield,
certain persons who came together with Chih opened
fire and killed Koo.

in Press? R.W.Y. 19/8

S. 1，特务科分署，
报告
日期：1939年8月18日。

事由：顾锦根（Koo Ching Keng，過錦根），据称为重庆政府在上海的秘密情报人员——被暗杀
呈报人：侦探副督察廖仲坚（Liao Chung Chien） 转呈人：C. Crawford？

1939年8月17日下午6时45分，一名叫顾锦根的男子，住址为越界筑路区勃伦安路（Brenan Road）旁曹家宅（Zao Ka Zah）158号，在其寓所门前被不明身份者开枪射杀。

据悉，顾系重庆政府秘密情报处成员，但在1939年7月，其多名同僚在法租界的联络点遭法国警察与日本军方联合搜查后，他便与该组织失去了联系。

此后，他居住在曹家宅158号，但不久其行踪和住址便被日本宪兵队获悉。日方随即指派一名叫金大麻皮（Chih Dah Mo Bi）的人去劝降顾锦根。金曾是重庆政府秘密情报处成员，目前作为秘密特工为日本宪兵队效力。据报道，8月17日晚，金前往拜访顾，当顾坚决拒绝投降时，随金同来的某些人开枪将顾打死。

SHANGHAI TIMES.

AUG 19 1939

MALE CHINESE SHOT
IN WESTERN AREA

Body Unidentified As
Police Investigate;
Four Shots Fired

An unidentified male Chinese was shot and fatally wounded reported-ly by two armed men in the vicinity of Tsackatse, which lies to the north of Brenan Piece, at about 5 p.m. on Thursday.

Altogether four shots were said to have been fired by the despera-does, only two shots found their mark. One bullet penetrated the victim's head and the other hit the abdomen.

The man's body fell dead near a small creek, and was seen by pedes-trians who later reported the mat-ter to Ta Tao police authorities.

The man was described as about 30 years old, of medium height, and wore a short jacket, and was be-lieved to be a shop assistant. The body remained unclaimed up till late last night.

The armed men fled immediately after the killing and no arrests were reported to have been made.

《字林西报》（SHANGHAI TIMES）

1939年8月19日

西区一华籍男子遭枪击

警方调查期间尸体身份未明；共开四枪

周四下午5时许，一名身份不明的华籍男子在位于勃伦安地块（Brenan Piece）以北的曹家宅（Tsackatse）附近，据报被两名持枪男子射击并受致命伤。

据说暴徒共开了四枪，其中两枪击中目标。一颗子弹穿透受害者头部，另一颗击中腹部。

该男子尸体倒毙于一条小浜附近，被路人发现，随后路人向大陶（Ta Tao，音译）警方当局报告了此事。

据描述，该男子约30岁，中等身材，身穿短夹克，被认为是一名店员。直至昨晚深夜，仍无人认领尸体。

行凶者在杀人后立即逃离，据报道未有逮捕行动。

AUG 1909

Shun Pao, Hwa Pao, Ta Mei Wan Pao (18/8), Chinese-American
Daily News :-

MURDER OF A MALE CHINESE IN WESTERN DISTRICT

(過金根), At 6 p.m. August 17, while Koo Ching-keng
aged 30, native of Kompo, was walking with a
man named Ching Dah Mo Bee (金大麻皮) along Sico Wu Pang
(小河浜) off Brenan Road, the latter drew his pistol
and fired three shots at Koo, wounding him in the head,
neck and lungs. Koo ran a few yards and fell dead in
front of House No.158 Zau Ka Zah (曹家宅). The gunman
made good his escape. The corpse has been encoffined
by his family.

1939年8月

《申报》、《华报》、《大美晚报》（8月18日），《中美日报》：

西区一华籍男子被谋杀

（顾金根），8月17日下午6时，30岁的金宝（Kompo，音译）籍男子顾锦根（Koo Ching-keng，過金根）与一名叫金大麻皮（Ching Dah Mo Bee）的男子沿勃伦安路旁的小河浜（Sico Wu Pang）行走时，后者拔出手枪向顾连开三枪，击中其头部、颈部和肺部。顾跑出数码后，倒在曹家宅（Zau Ka Zah）158号门前身亡。枪手成功逃脱。尸体已由其家属收殓。
